releaseNotes.zh-CN:
ADC 0.2.2（测试版）

中文名称为「ADC 设备云」，英文名称为「ADC」。
修复页面与底部标签切换时的闪动：移除整页淡入，保留各页面滚动位置，加载条不再挤动内容。
设备列表在后台刷新时保留已有内容，允许正常切换页面；相同内容不再重复重建，刷新不会覆盖正在编辑的设备设置。
「我的 → 语言」支持跟随系统、中文与 English。Android 13 及以上同时支持系统的单应用语言设置。
界面、后台通知与更新说明跟随所选语言，切换语言不会重启手机 Node。
此手机与使用指南改为通用 Android 后台运行说明，移除品牌专属提示。

沿用已安装测试版的签名，可覆盖升级并保留配对、账号和本地权限。安装仍需 Android 系统确认。
releaseNotes.en:
ADC 0.2.2 (preview)

The app is named ADC in English and ADC 设备云 in Chinese.
Removes page fades that caused flashes during navigation. Each tab retains its scroll position and the loading bar no longer shifts content.
Background device refresh keeps cached content and navigation available. Unchanged rows remain in place, and refresh never replaces an open device-settings draft.
Account → Language offers Follow system, 中文 and English. Android 13+ also supports the system's per-app language setting.
The interface, background notifications and update notes use the selected language. Changing language does not restart the phone Node.
Phone controls and the guide now use general Android background-availability instructions.

Retains the installed preview certificate for in-place upgrades, preserving pairing, account and local permissions. Android confirmation is still required for installation.
